mame_studio2.name: MAME Current (RCA Studio II)
mame_studio2.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for RCA Studio II via MAME software-list emulation. Requires studio2.zip and studio2.xml. Studio II games are monochrome and may boot to a corrupted-looking screen until the console receives Clear plus a keypad selection. RetroArch game focus must be enabled so MAME sees keyboard keypad input: Clear is F3; Keypad A 1-9 are Q/W/E/A/S/D/Z/X/C and Keypad A 0 is Left Alt.

mednafen_wswan.name: Beetle WonderSwan
mednafen_wswan.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Bandai WonderSwan and WonderSwan Color. No BIOS required.

genesis_plus_gx_sms.name: Genesis Plus GX (Master System)
genesis_plus_gx_sms.notes: RetroArch fallback core profile for Sega Master System / Mark III. Uses genesis_plus_gx_libretro.so; Master System boot ROMs are optional.

mame_neogeo.name: MAME Current (Neo Geo)
mame_neogeo.notes: Recommended installed RetroArch path for SNK Neo Geo using MAME arcade ZIP sets. Requires neogeo.zip and zipped game sets kept intact.

fbneo_neogeo.name: FinalBurn Neo (Neo Geo)
fbneo_neogeo.notes: Preferred lightweight arcade path when fbneo_libretro.so is installed. Requires neogeo.zip and FBNeo-compatible zipped game sets.
